description:
**Phase D — Summarization LLM call. Deps: D2.**

Add the reasoning conditional from `tmp/pi-mono/.../compaction/compaction.ts:569-572`:
- Condition: `model.reasoning && thinking_level && thinking_level !== "off"`
- When true: thread `reasoning: thinking_level` into the producer's `StreamOptions`.
- When false: omit `reasoning` field entirely.

Thread `thinking_level` param through `Compaction.Summary.generate/N` callers.

Tests: port `tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/test/compaction-summary-reasoning.test.ts` — three unit cases against the producer-injection seam from D2:
- reasoning model + level → `reasoning:` set on StreamOptions
- reasoning model + `:off` → omitted
- non-reasoning model + any level → omitted

The live end-to-end thinking-model compaction test from
`tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/test/compaction-thinking-model.test.ts`
is split off into a separate ticket because it requires Session.compact/2 (E4),
Compaction.compact (E1), CompactionSummaryMessage serialization (E3),
CompactionEntry append (E5b), and SettingsManager (A4) — none of which exist yet
when D3 lands.
title: D3. Reasoning/thinking-level support in generate_summary
